readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 可以 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: A person bends under a shoulder strap, then straightens by means of it; 可以 gives permission to use it, while yǐ follows the dip and recovery.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 知道 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: A mouth fires a dart-straight answer across a high, level line: 知道—to know. Hold zhī as steady as the dart’s flight.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 应该 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: An obligation sign stays fixed overhead: 应该—ought to. Hold gāi high and level like the rule that will not move.
